note: The versions production's supabase_migrations.schema_migrations table is expected to hold.
This exists so the offline drift check has something to compare the files against without
needing a credential, and so a stale ledger is a diff in a pull request rather than a
discovery months later. Update it in the same commit as any new migration.
It is a snapshot, not the source of truth: only `npm run migrations:verify:live` can tell
